import json, os, sys
repo = sys.argv[1]
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(repo, "lib"))
import cli_help, cli_catalog, command_chains, model_watch

d = json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
cat = cli_catalog.load_catalog(os.path.join(repo, 'config/cli-commands.json'))
det = {k: (set(v) if v is not None else None) for k, v in d['detected'].items()}
kw = dict(versions=d['versions'], accounts=d['accounts'], models=d['models'], new_models=d['new_models'], helps=d['helps'])
print(json.dumps([cli_catalog.catalog_view(cat, detected=det, **kw), cli_catalog.catalog_view(cat, **kw)]))
